_comment: v9: the same weights as v8. What changed is not in this file. (1) The scripted bots are no longer omniscient - they see with the engine's bullet rule, chase the last place they saw you for a few seconds, then give up (botVision.ts), so breaking contact is possible at all. (2) The retreat term now pays for the break-off as well as for being un-shootable inside the fight (rewards.py _intent_term), because until the bots could lose you the second route was unreachable and paying for it would have been paying for nothing. Bars measured against the old omniscient bots do not transfer: see out/rl/bars_vs_seeing_bots.json.
